contentText:
Tame Impala and JENNIE break into the top 10 of the Hot 100. Can Olivia Rodrigo’s “Drop Dead” hold on to another week at No. 1, or will one of Ella Langley’s three entries in the top 10 come for the No. 1 spot?

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 for the week dated May 16. Tame Impala and JENNIE join the top 10. “Folded” is up a spot. Ella and Morgan slip to eight. “Ordinary” rises to seven. “So Easy” is locked at six. “I Just Might” drops to five, and “Man I Need” to No. 4. “Drop Dead” is up to three, as is “Be Her” to No. 2. And grabbing a ninth week at No. 1 is “Choosin’ Texas.”
